title: Interview Flashcards & GCFA Exam Prep: Digital Forensics

flashcards.question: What is Chain of Custody and why is it essential in court?
flashcards.answer: Chain of Custody is the chronological paper trail or electronic log showing the seizure, custody, control, transfer, analysis, and disposition of digital evidence. Without a clear chain of custody, evidence can be ruled inadmissible in court due to potential tampering.

flashcards.question: Why is a hardware write-blocker mandatory during disk acquisition?
flashcards.answer: Connecting a storage drive directly to an OS allows the OS to alter timestamps, write system metadata, or modify files. A hardware write-blocker prevents any write signals from reaching the evidence disk, guaranteeing a 100% byte-exact duplicate.

flashcards.question: What Windows Event IDs are most critical during breach investigation?
flashcards.answer: Event ID 4624 (Logon Success), Event ID 4625 (Logon Failed), Event ID 4720 (User Account Created), Event ID 7045 (New Service Installed - common for malware persistence), and Event ID 1102 (Audit Log Cleared).
